names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 17 februarie, «Sfântul Ierarh Ermoghen, Patriarhul Moscovei».

Read out of saint.gr's line for 17 Φεβρουαρίου, «Άγιος Ερμογένης ο Ιερομάρτυρας Πατριάρχης Μόσχας», with the rank words and the see left off. The page gives his baptismal name in Greek as «Ερμόλαος»; no Russian form is printed on it, and none is invented here.

birth.note: doxologia.ro's life: «Acesta se născu în Kazan în preajma anului 1530» — the page gives no year but an approximation, and the interval is set as an approximation.

death.note: doxologia.ro's life: «la 17 februarie 1612, din pricina foamei, să își dea sufletul său cel râvnitor în mâinile Domnului».

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 17 februarie — «Sfântul Ierarh Ermoghen, Patriarhul Moscovei»

feast.note: saint.gr adds a second Greek day of its own at the end of his page — «Η μνήμη του Αγίου Ερμογένη επαναλαμβάνεται στις 12 Μαΐου» — his memory is repeated on 12 May (https://www.saint.gr/1570/saint.aspx, read 30 September 2026); the 12 May Greek day page was not read. The same page dates his death to 17 January 1612, which is neither of the two days it keeps him on.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 17ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Άγιος Ερμογένης ο Ιερομάρτυρας Πατριάρχης Μόσχας»

attestations.note: Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).
